page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 48.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance includes 670 GB of local SSD storage, providing direct-attached solid-state capacity for applications requiring local disk access. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and bundled local SSD storage offer a balanced resource density for workloads requiring predictable compute performance and local storage without the overhead of external network-attached volumes.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and local SSD storage, the ecs.i1.3xlarge is suited for general-purpose workloads, medium-sized databases, web serving, and development environments that benefit from dedicated CPU resources and local storage capacity.
